scripts.text:
[Ricael]
You must be lost...
Why would anyone come
to this horrid, dreadful
place on purpose...??
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
你一定是迷路了...
谁会故意来到这种
可怕又糟糕的地方呢...??

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
Ever since I stumbled fell down into this giant tree, I've suffered endlessly here. I've wasted years in sadness, being unable to escape Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
自从我不小心掉进这棵巨树以来，我就在这里遭受着无尽的痛苦。我在悲伤中虚度了数年，无法逃离尼弗海姆。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
But in searching for an
escape route, I probably know
this town better than anyone
else. I guess knowing the
layout might help you escape
if it weren't so futile.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
不过在寻找出口的过程中，我想我对这座城镇的了解比任何人都多。虽然这毫无意义，但了解布局或许能帮你逃离这里。

scripts.text: Ask building locations.
scripts.translation: 询问建筑位置

scripts.text: Remove marks on the mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图上的标记

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
So, um, which place do you want to know about?
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
那么，呃，你想了解哪个地方？

scripts.text: Witch's castle
scripts.translation: 女巫的城堡

scripts.text: Tool shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Weapon shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Pub
scripts.translation: 酒吧

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
There. I made a ^FF3355+^000000 mark
on your mini-map so that you can
go to the castle where that
creepy witch lives.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
好了。我在你的小地图上做了一个^FF3355+^000000标记，这样你就可以去那个住着可怕女巫的城堡了。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
I went there once, but then I
ran away and decided that I
should try to not die as much
as possible. That's pretty
much my life goal here in
Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
我有一次去过那里，但我逃跑了，并决定尽可能少死几次。这大概是我在尼弗海姆的人生目标。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
The Tool shop is located
at the ^CE6300+^000000 mark I made
on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
工具店位于我在你小地图上做的^CE6300+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
They sell some unique items that
you cannot find outside of this
town. Of course, they weren't so
special once I realized no
Potion can ease the pain I feel.
...I wish I was in prison.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
他们卖一些你在城镇外找不到的独特物品。当然，当我意识到没有任何药水能缓解我内心的痛苦时，它们也就没什么特别了。
...我宁愿在监狱里。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
The Weapon shop is located
at the ^55FF33+^000000 mark I made
on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
武器店位于我在你小地图上做的^55FF33+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
They sell some unique items which
you cannot find outside of this
town... Of course, fighting
the monsters here will just
make them angrier. You may as
well let them eat you.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
他们卖一些你在城镇外找不到的独特物品...当然，在这里与魔物战斗只会让它们更愤怒。你最好还是让它们吃掉你吧。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
The Pub is located at
the ^3355FF+^000000 mark I've made
on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
酒馆位于我在你小地图上做的^3355FF+^000000标记处。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
Sometimes I see dead people in the
Pub enjoying themselves, having a
good time. I used to be able to
have fun once, but now all I feel
is the cold tingle of loneliness
and despair...every waking moment.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
有时候我看到死人在酒馆里尽情享乐，玩得很开心。我曾经也能享受乐趣，但现在我只感到孤独和绝望的冰冷刺痛...每一个清醒的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
If you want to remove the location
marks from your mini-map, please
choose 'Remove marks on the
mini-map' from the menu.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
如果你想移除小地图上的位置标记，请从菜单中选择“移除小地图上的标记”。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
I removed the location marks from
your mini-map. Go ahead and ask
me if you want to mark the
building locations again. It
helps me ignore the depression
that gnaws at me constantly.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
我已经移除了你小地图上的位置标记。如果你还想标记建筑位置，尽管再问我。这能帮我暂时忽略那不断啃噬我的抑郁。

scripts.text:
[Ricael]
It's not a good idea to search
Niflheim by yourself...
At least try to be careful.
scripts.translation:
[里卡埃尔]
独自探索尼弗海姆并不是个好主意...
至少请小心一点。
